```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)

find_package_root <- function(path = getwd()) {
  path <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  while (!file.exists(file.path(path, "DESCRIPTION"))) {
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Could not find package root containing DESCRIPTION.")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
  return(path)
}

package_root <- find_package_root()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = package_root)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 7,
  fig.height = 7,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE
)

devtools::load_all(package_root, quiet = TRUE)

make_moo <- function() {
  return(create_multiOmicDataSet_from_dataframes(
    as.data.frame(nidap_sample_metadata),
    as.data.frame(nidap_clean_raw_counts),
    sample_id_colname = "Sample",
    feature_id_colname = "Gene"
  ))
}

run_filter <- function(moo, interactive_plots) {
  return(filter_counts(
    moo,
    count_type = "raw",
    sample_id_colname = "Sample",
    feature_id_colname = "Gene",
    group_colname = "Group",
    label_colname = "Label",
    color_histogram_by_group = TRUE,
    plot_corr_matrix_heatmap = TRUE,
    print_plots = TRUE,
    save_plots = FALSE,
    interactive_plots = interactive_plots
  ))
}

run_normalize <- function(moo, interactive_plots) {
  return(normalize_counts(
    moo,
    count_type = "filt",
    group_colname = "Group",
    label_colname = "Label",
    color_histogram_by_group = TRUE,
    plot_corr_matrix_heatmap = TRUE,
    print_plots = TRUE,
    save_plots = FALSE,
    interactive_plots = interactive_plots
  ))
}

run_batch <- function(moo, interactive_plots) {
  return(batch_correct_counts(
    moo,
    count_type = "norm",
    sub_count_type = "voom",
    sample_id_colname = "Sample",
    feature_id_colname = "Gene",
    covariates_colnames = "Group",
    batch_colname = "Batch",
    label_colname = "Label",
    color_histogram_by_group = TRUE,
    plot_corr_matrix_heatmap = TRUE,
    print_plots = TRUE,
    save_plots = FALSE,
    interactive_plots = interactive_plots
  ))
}
```

## Static Wrapper Plots

This section runs the wrappers with `interactive_plots = FALSE`. Each wrapper prints the plots it creates.

```{r static-filter}
moo_static <- make_moo()
moo_static <- run_filter(moo_static, interactive_plots = FALSE)
cat("Filtered dimensions:", paste(dim(moo_static@counts$filt), collapse = " x "), "\n")
```

```{r static-normalize}
moo_static <- run_normalize(moo_static, interactive_plots = FALSE)
cat("Normalized dimensions:", paste(dim(moo_static@counts$norm$voom), collapse = " x "), "\n")
```

```{r static-batch}
moo_static <- run_batch(moo_static, interactive_plots = FALSE)
cat("Batch-corrected dimensions:", paste(dim(moo_static@counts$batch), collapse = " x "), "\n")
```

## Interactive Wrapper Plots

This section reruns the same wrappers on a fresh object with `interactive_plots = TRUE`. PCA and histogram outputs should render as interactive plotly widgets.

```{r interactive-filter}
moo_interactive <- make_moo()
moo_interactive <- run_filter(moo_interactive, interactive_plots = TRUE)
cat("Filtered dimensions:", paste(dim(moo_interactive@counts$filt), collapse = " x "), "\n")
```

```{r interactive-normalize}
moo_interactive <- run_normalize(moo_interactive, interactive_plots = TRUE)
cat("Normalized dimensions:", paste(dim(moo_interactive@counts$norm$voom), collapse = " x "), "\n")
```

```{r interactive-batch}
moo_interactive <- run_batch(moo_interactive, interactive_plots = TRUE)
cat("Batch-corrected dimensions:", paste(dim(moo_interactive@counts$batch), collapse = " x "), "\n")
```

## Count Slot Summary

```{r count-slot-summary}
summary_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  mode = c("static", "static", "static", "interactive", "interactive", "interactive"),
  slot = c("filt", "norm$voom", "batch", "filt", "norm$voom", "batch"),
  rows = c(
    nrow(moo_static@counts$filt),
    nrow(moo_static@counts$norm$voom),
    nrow(moo_static@counts$batch),
    nrow(moo_interactive@counts$filt),
    nrow(moo_interactive@counts$norm$voom),
    nrow(moo_interactive@counts$batch)
  ),
  columns = c(
    ncol(moo_static@counts$filt),
    ncol(moo_static@counts$norm$voom),
    ncol(moo_static@counts$batch),
    ncol(moo_interactive@counts$filt),
    ncol(moo_interactive@counts$norm$voom),
    ncol(moo_interactive@counts$batch)
  )
)

print(summary_tbl)
```
